PROJECTS_GUIDE.md.summary: `PROJECTS_GUIDE.md` is a documentation file detailing the directory structure, asset handling, and metadata schema for portfolio projects within the workspace configuration.

DEVELOPEMENT.md.summary: `DEVELOPMENT.md` documents the portfolio repository's architecture, configuration-driven project pipeline, and session implementation tasks. It serves as an internal development log and architectural reference for the project.

Dockerfile.summary: This file defines a multi-stage container build using Node.js and Nginx to compile and serve the production static bundle. It plays a crucial role in containerizing the application for deployment.

components.json.summary: `components.json` configures the shadcn/ui component library, defining styling, paths, and TypeScript aliases. It serves as the primary setup file for integrating UI components into the project.

README.md.summary: This `README.md` file documents the developer portfolio website, detailing setup instructions, build commands, and the project's JSON-driven configuration architecture.

config/portfolio-header.json.summary: `config/portfolio-header.json` defines JSON data for the portfolio header, supplying profile metadata, titles, descriptions, and action buttons to structure the main landing section.

config/projects/MusicBot/project.json.summary: This JSON metadata file defines the project configuration, dependencies, and deployment details for the `MusicBot` project, serving as its core project manifest.

config/projects/cpp-ml-interface/project.summary: This file defines project metadata for the `cpp-ml-interface` module, detailing its C++ CFD-to-ML coupling layer configuration. It serves as the project manifest within the portfolio configuration.

config/projects/advoexport/project.json.summary: This JSON configuration file defines project metadata and architecture details for `advoexport`, a custom legacy legal data migration ETL pipeline. It serves as the project's primary configuration manifest.

config/projects/cycling-power-estimator/.summary: This JSON file defines the project metadata and configuration for the Cycling Power Estimator. It serves as the primary project manifest within the portfolio.

config/projects/exam-system-backend/proj.summary: This metadata file defines project configuration and metadata for the `exam-system-backend` microservice. It serves as a portfolio project definition for the LLM-Integrated Exam System.

config/projects/custom-orchestration/pro.summary: This JSON configuration file defines metadata, dependencies, and architectural strengths for the `custom-orchestration` project. It serves as the project's portfolio definition file within the portfolio configuration system.
